exposure: ezParent program (digitally delivered behavioral parent training)
outcome: parent access and use of ezParent and coaching calls
cohort: Ten parents of very low birth weight (VLBW) infants, 20 months of age adjusted for prematurity, recruited from a neonatal intensive care follow-up clinic.
finding: Parents completed a high percentage of the ezParent modules and coaching calls, showing modest improvements in parenting self-efficacy and child externalizing behavior, and found the program content applicable and coaching calls highly satisfactory.
